freeze_requirements: Every null value in locked_sha256 and baseline_source must be filled with a real hash or commit before any training or validation access.
After filling them, change state to FROZEN_BEFORE_MILESTONE_A_DATA_ACCESS and record the SHA-256 of this file in the authorization record.
No decision threshold in this file may change after freeze.
purpose: Measure how a published point-cloud segmentation architecture, reduced to the same 4 GB budget and trained and evaluated under the same protocol as S7, compares with S7 on full-cloud validation. The outcome decides whether S7 has a defensible position at this budget. It is not a reproduction of any published number and does not authorize test-split access.
decision_question: At matched budget, split, crop, seeds, epochs and evaluator, is the baseline's mean paired full-cloud validation Part IoU higher than, comparable to, or lower than S7's?

primary.name: PointNeXt-S reduced to budget
primary.published_reference_not_comparable: Test PartIoU 29.56 and ShapeIoU 21.76 from the BuildingNet challenge report (arXiv 2306.10146, Table 8). That run used 40,000-point samples and 100 epochs; it is a public reference only and must not be placed in the same column as this measurement.
allowed_reductions: Input points per crop fixed at 4096 to match S7.
Batch size reduced from 8 by halving until the memory gate passes; the final value is recorded.
Channel width reduced only if batch size 1 still exceeds the memory gate; any reduction is recorded and flagged.
primary.reductions_that_void_the_comparison: Any change to the architecture family beyond the listed reductions, or fewer than 4096 input points, changes the result to a self-modified baseline and must be reported as such.

secondary_floor.name: PointNet++ (same budget)
secondary_floor.role: Lower reference only. Not used in the decision rule.

baselines.fallback_if_primary_infeasible: PTv3 at the smallest official configuration, under the same allowed reductions. If it also fails, the stage ends with outcome INFEASIBLE_AT_BUDGET.

matching_conditions.input_features: normalized XYZ, unit normals, RGB, identical to S7
matching_conditions.full_building_normalization: cached before sampling, identical to S7
matching_conditions.point_masses: The baseline receives no mass input unless its architecture has a native per-point weight input; none is planned.
matching_conditions.objective: BalancedCEWithLovasz with lovasz_weight 0.5 and the same train-count class weights as S7.
matching_conditions.optimizer_and_schedule: AdamW, weight decay 1e-4, cosine annealing to 1e-6, BF16 autocast, identical to S7 except the learning rate described below.
matching_conditions.checkpoint_selection: Best fixed-crop validation Part IoU, earliest epoch on exact ties, identical to S7.
matching_conditions.class_handling: Raw label 0 ignored by loss and metrics; 31 classes; identical to S7.

hyperparameter_allowance.rationale: S7's objective and learning rate were chosen in earlier stages. To avoid an under-tuned baseline, the baseline receives one small pre-declared search, and only one.
hyperparameter_allowance.selection_metric: Fixed-crop validation Part IoU at epoch 5
hyperparameter_allowance.selection_rule: Higher value wins; tie goes to 0.001.
hyperparameter_allowance.after_selection: The chosen learning rate is used unchanged for all three confirmatory seeds. The search run for seed 42 is not counted as a confirmatory replicate.

evaluation.protocol: Same full-cloud evaluator logic as S7: padded, permuted 4096-point chunks, three votes.
evaluation.metrics_implementation: Same implementation file and hash as the S7 validation evaluations.

s7_reference.note: S7 values are used as recorded. They are not re-run. Comparison uses seed-matched paired deltas.

memory_gate.on_failure: Apply the allowed reductions in order. If the gate still fails at batch size 1 and the smallest allowed width, record INFEASIBLE_AT_BUDGET for that baseline.

decision_rule.statistic: Mean over the three seeds of (baseline full-cloud validation Part IoU minus S7 full-cloud validation Part IoU), seed-matched.
decision_rule.minimum_effect_source: Existing protocol minimum Part-IoU effect used in the S5 headline criterion and the S7 gate.

outcomes.BASELINE_SUPERIOR: Mean paired difference >= +minimum_effect. S7 has no defensible accuracy position at this budget. Recommended project action: stop the Q1-directed line and report a negative result.
outcomes.COMPARABLE: Mean paired difference strictly between -minimum_effect and +minimum_effect. S7 cannot claim an accuracy advantage; any claim must rest on efficiency (memory, latency, parameters) and be stated as such.
outcomes.S7_SUPERIOR: Mean paired difference <= -minimum_effect. S7 retains a measured advantage at this budget; the five-seed and mass-attribution work may be considered.
outcomes.INFEASIBLE_AT_BUDGET: The baseline cannot run within the memory gate after the allowed reductions. Record the evidence. No accuracy comparison is made, and the stage cannot support or refute S7's position.

decision_rule.secondary_reporting: Shape IoU, accuracy, head/mid/tail IoU and the efficiency metrics are reported descriptively. They do not alter the outcome.
decision_rule.statistical_caution: Three seed pairs. A paired t-test may be reported as supporting evidence only. No headline claim is authorized.

budget_and_stop_rules.on_budget_exhausted: Stop, report what completed, and set the outcome to INCOMPLETE. Do not extend without a new written authorization.
budget_and_stop_rules.on_dependency_failure: After three documented failed installation or build attempts, try the fallback baseline once. If it also fails, record INFEASIBLE_AT_BUDGET.
budget_and_stop_rules.thermal_or_power_interruption: Resume from the last complete epoch checkpoint with full RNG restoration, as in the S8 runner.

interpretation_limits.validation_set_reuse: The same 187 validation buildings were used for S7 development. The comparison is a development-set comparison, not an out-of-sample estimate.

consequence_for_project_rules.stop_rule_clause_b: Clause (b), baseline at matched budget not below S7, is satisfied by BASELINE_SUPERIOR and, at the user's discretion, by COMPARABLE. INFEASIBLE_AT_BUDGET and INCOMPLETE leave clause (b) unresolved.
